questions.explain: Retrieval recall@k (retrieval path in isolation), answer groundedness (most important quality metric — every claim traces to a cited chunk), citation precision/recall, expected-point coverage, and user feedback rate.
options: Retrieval recall@k, answer groundedness, citation precision/recall, expected-point coverage, user feedback rate
questions.q: What are the five metrics that matter for RAG evaluation?

questions.explain: Judge with a different model than the generator, calibrate against humans quarterly (85% agreement threshold), score with rubrics and structured quotable output, and keep raw judgments as auditable evidence.
options: Always use the same model as the generator
Different model than generator, quarterly human calibration, rubric-based structured scoring, raw judgments kept

questions.explain: The weekly loop: run evals on every prompt/config change before deploy (config_snapshot makes runs reproducible), diff metrics between runs for regressions, promote production failures into the golden set, and track trends with deploy markers.
options: Eval every change pre-deploy, diff runs for regressions, promote failures into the golden set, track trends

questions.explain: Feedback is captured frictionlessly (up/down/regenerated + category like wrong/incomplete/hallucinated) and mined for golden-set additions — every real failure becomes a future regression test.
options: Feedback is too noisy to use
Capture up/down/regenerated with categories, and mine down-voted answers for golden-set additions
